# Davuud Ghani

> London brand consultant and AI systems builder, and founder of Pivitt. He builds the brands, and the AI systems behind them, that let a business move faster without losing itself.

Davuud Ghani sets a business's position, identity and story, and builds the AI systems that keep its work on brand and moving quickly. The brand work runs through Pivitt (https://pivitt.co.uk), the London consultancy he founded. The AI systems started as the ones Pivitt runs on.

## Facts
- Name: Davuud Ghani
- Role: brand consultant and AI systems builder; founder of Pivitt (Pivitt Ltd)
- Based: London, working with clients across the UK and worldwide
- Works with: founders, CEOs and marketing leaders, mostly in professional services, property and investment
- Contact: hello@davuud.com; https://www.linkedin.com/in/davuudghani/
- Record: 200,000+ assets produced across an 8-year BMW Group partnership, 160+ campaigns; helped scale a start-up investment business past £40M in revenue in eighteen months; helped grow a UK home services business from £300k to £2.18M in revenue, 118% above target
- Engagements are scoped and priced to the business before they start

## What he builds
- Brand strategy, positioning and identity, through Pivitt
- An operating memory a team and its AI tools work from
- Brief capture: client emails become tracked briefs with every file
- A brand system AI tools can follow: voice, approved claims, rules and checks on every draft
- Document production from one source, checked before it leaves
- A daily brief and weekly review
- Research and outreach: tender and trigger research, written sequences, reply tracking
